brief: Meal kits starting around $8 a serving, new customer discounts big. We want busy families and young professionals. Weekly subscription.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.58-$0.77 per click (median $0.65), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.53-$0.75 (median $0.63); bidding $0.40 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.40 per click (second price)
